text:
alex_varma: Heads-up — saw a steady uptick in corrected ECC events and remap-rate on pool14 GPUs (cards 5-8) over the last 24h. Grafana panels show remap/sec jump x4, and a few Xid 13s near same window.
cheng_liu: ugh. any page-retire alerts? link to graph: https://grafana.company/r/pool14/remap-rate :eyes:
alex_varma: ops-bot posted automated alert at 1769001200 — threshold breached for remap_rate. Also attached snippet from node logs: ```nvml: ecc_corrected=124->410 over 12h
Xid 13 at 2025-06-15T09:12:03Z on card5
remap_count card5=4200 card6=3800 card7=4100 card8=95```
maria-gonzalez: card8 looks new-ish compared to others — might be a flake or recently added host. Can we cross-check bios/firmware?
jamal: agreed. running nvml dump + smi health checks now, will post results. If cards 5-7 trending, we should plan drain window.
cheng_liu: quick query I ran: `sum(rate(gpu_mem_remap_total{pool="pool14"}[6h])) by (card)` shows sustained slope on 5-7. Not just spikes.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2458 for pool14 memory attrition; suggested next steps: isolate cards, schedule maintenance, notify capacity owners.
alex_varma: capacity note — pool14 is serving low-priority workloads but current reserved jobs will bump if we drain 4 cards simultaneously. Propose staggered drain: drain card5 this morning, card6 midday, card7 tonight.
maria-gonzalez: +1. Also request to push health-check memtest overnight (non-destructive) and replace cards if remap growth doesn't flatten after drain.
jamal: nvml dumps: firmware v52 on card5/6/7, card8 is v51. No obvious PCI errors. I'll open a vendor ticket if memtest shows ECC corrections continue.
cheng_liu: can we add a temporary routing policy to avoid long-seq generation tasks on pool14? That will lower KV cache pressure and may reduce page retirement churn.
alex_varma: noted. I've added a canary rule to route gen.long to pool-other for next 6h. Monitoring.
maria-gonzalez: if replacement needed, vendor lead time ~3 business days. Ops, please coordinate spare allocation and update INC-2458 with ETA.
jamal: memtest scheduled 23:00 UTC. Will post results and recommended action in this thread.
sre_oncall_bot: reminder — postmortem flag will be applied if INC-2458 escalates to outage.
alex_varma: thanks all. tagging @cheng_liu @maria-gonzalez for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
